scripts.gen:api: npm run spec && openapi-typescript openapi/openapi.yaml -o frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.mock: npm run spec && node mock/build-mock.mjs && prism mock mock/openapi.mock.yaml -p 3000 --cors
scripts.dev: concurrently -n mock,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:mock" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run spec && npm --prefix frontend run build
